title: Sheaf condition for the stage-generated abelian subpresheaf
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $j$, let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Assume every covering presieve has finitely many arrows. Each transition functor $F(a)$ maps covering presieves to covering presieves, preserves pullbacks of a covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone of $F$ whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism and covering-pullback properties. Its covers are precisely transported images along the $V_j$ of stage covers. Assume each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix i, G and alpha satisfying the unit equations as in the stage-representative problem. The explicit presheaf of additive subgroups generated by restrictions of all stage images [ def-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-stage-image ] is a sheaf for Q.toGrothendieck. This conclusion is only the sheaf condition; it does not assert representatives at forward images or choose any data.

proof.text: Present every limit object by stages above i. Use object and arrow representatives, filtered common refinements, and eventual equality to obtain a filtered presentation category and well-defined restriction maps for the filtered colimit Braw of stage inverse-image sections. Transition maps are the uniquely unit-characterized adjuncts; h-alpha identifies their composites into the canonical inverse image with the supplied alpha.

Lift every Q cover to a finite stage cover by hQ and hfinite; use preservation of covering pullbacks to lift its finite matching diagram. The stage sheaf equalizers commute with the filtered colimit of abelian groups, including the empty equalizer, hence Braw is a sheaf.

Compatible maps from Braw to H transpose into a single map from G to V_i restriction of H, and conversely. The unit and identity presentation give inverse assignments, by uniqueness of adjuncts. Thus Braw is canonically the inverse image with compatible unit. Its presentation images are the supplied alpha images; restrictions are other presentation images and finite sums have a common refinement. The explicitly defined stage-generated presheaf is therefore its image under this isomorphism and is a sheaf.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_stage_image_isSheaf
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
 :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf Q.toGrothendieck
      (ColimitSiteStageImage.presheaf F P V Q i G α)
